_comment: Claude Code MCP topology for the local AI dev platform. Startup order is encoded by 'startup_order' (lower starts first). Every server runs locally over stdio; none binds a network port. Servers launch as installed modules: 'python -m claudenv.adapters.mcp.<module>.server'. The 'command' uses the platform venv Python (${CLAUDE_ENV_HOME}/venv/bin/python) where the claudenv package is installed, so all server deps are isolated. Register with: claude mcp add <name> -- ${CLAUDE_ENV_HOME}/venv/bin/python -m claudenv.adapters.mcp.<module>.server

filesystem-policy.description: Policy-enforcing filesystem access. Wraps every read/write with the repo policy engine + content scanner. The ONLY sanctioned path to the filesystem for agents.

git.description: Read-mostly git access (log, diff, blame, status, show). State-mutating operations (push, amend, rebase, reset --hard) are denied here and must go through the approval gate.

lancedb-rag.description: Local RAG retrieval over the LanceDB index. Exposes hybrid search + rerank. Read-only; indexing happens out-of-band via the rag/ scripts.

env._comment_models: Embedding + reranker model selection lives in config/rag.yaml (configured at setup), NOT here. To override per-server, you may set EMBED_MODEL_PATH / EMBED_DIM / EMBED_DOC_PREFIX / EMBED_QUERY_PREFIX / RERANKER_DIR here, but no model is hardcoded by default.

memory-graph.description: Local memory graph (SQLite). Namespaced; isolation enforced per repo policy. Reads are open to permitted agents; writes/deletes are audited and deletes are approval-gated.

terminal.description: Constrained command execution. Only an allow-listed set of read/test/benchmark/audit commands run automatically; anything state-mutating is denied and routed to the approval gate. No unrestricted shell.

documentation.description: Local documentation index + controlled fetch. External fetch is permitted only for tier-0/tier-1 repos; tier-2/tier-3 are restricted to the local docs corpus.

jetbrains.description: JetBrains IDE bridge (provided by the JetBrains MCP plugin). Exposes editor context, inspections, refactor actions, and run configurations to Claude Code. Starts last; depends on a running IDE instance.
